note: Upstream provenance map for tests ported from happy-dom: every entry records the upstream file path, the ADR-0002 section 1 pinned commit, the MIT license and the local ledger id (hc-up-* for hand-written up-suite cases, hc-hdunit-* for hdunit per-file entries). Only cases that depend on the public API may be ported; localPath files must never reference happy-dom private internals (validated mechanically by compat/validate-ledger.js and tests/happy-dom/validate-triage.mjs). For the hdunit suite (ADR-0006) an entry is registered for every enabled rewritten test file; skip/expected-fail files are not mapped. web-platform-tests cases are a separate upstream (BSD-3-Clause) and are mapped in tests/wpt/manifest.json (T48), not here.
